scripts.build: pnpm --dir ghostmark install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline --prod=false && pnpm --dir ghostmark build
scripts.build:storefront: pnpm --dir ghostmark-storefront install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir ghostmark-storefront build
scripts.cms:dev: pnpm --filter ./cms dev || (cd cms && npm run dev)
scripts.cms:build: pnpm --filter ./cms build || (cd cms && npm run build)
